arrangement: A large workshop view fills the left two thirds. Two smaller views stack at right with narrow pale gutters.

regions.depiction: A compact blue maintenance robot leans over a workbench, seen from behind. Its right gripper rests beside an open brass latch.

subjects.depiction: The robot's rounded blue back and planted feet establish its stance at the bench.
subjects.pose_and_body_geometry: Body inclined toward the latch, both feet planted, right arm extended over the bench.

regions.depiction: A close view shows the open brass latch beside the robot's blue gripper. The detached pin lies across the latch mouth.

subjects.depiction: Only the blue gripper enters beside the latch.
subjects.props_and_contacts: The gripper hovers beside the detached pin. The latch and pin rest on the workbench.

regions.depiction: A close front view of the same robot's square amber display shows a single raised white indicator line.

subjects.depiction: The amber display and its raised white indicator line occupy most of the region.

relationships.relation: The detail enlarges the latch in the workshop view at the same instant.
The display belongs to the robot inspecting this latch at the same instant, seen from the other side.
